Our valued client, ECS Solutions are seeking to employ suitably qualified Welders to join their busy team of professionals working out of their Murarrie depot.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Read and interpret project plans, engineering drawings, blueprints and other written instructions and diagrams to perform task at hand
Perform fabrication and repair works on various metal structures and components according to engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Work with variety of materials, including steel, aluminium, and other alloys
Weld small and large components such as copper plumbing, beams, and pipelines.
Perform appropriate type of weld - base on project needs and specifications
Weld components in flat, vertical, and overhead positions.
Ensure fabrication and repairs are carried out using the proper safety guidelines to ensure rework jobs do not occur.
Use a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Conduct quality checks on completed work to ensure it meets standard specifications
Monitor machinery for appropriate usage and temperature
Follow and enforce strict safety regulations such as wearing heat-resistant gloves, protective masks, and safety shoes to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace.

To be considered for this role, you must have the following:
Trade certificate in Engineering Fabrication or Equivalent
Proficient in performing all welding, gouging, cutting or other duties
Post trade experience in the same field
Proactive attitude with the desire to work reliably as part of an outstanding team to deliver excellence for our clients
Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and blueprints
Experience working with a variety of materials, including steel, aluminum, and other alloys
Familiarity with a range of hand and power tools, including grinders, drills, and cutting tools
Strong attention to detail and the ability to conduct quality checks on completed work
Ability to work independently or as part of a team to complete assigned tasks
Knowledge of safety procedures and regulations to prevent accidents and injuries in the workplace
Strong communication and reporting skills
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
AMA 

AMA Group is the leader in collision repair, with the biggest network of facilities across Australia and New Zealand, supported by Australia’s leading distributor of vehicle parts and accessories. Our Team provides repairs for light to high-severity collisions — on everything from small private vehicles and prestige cars to commercial trucks and buses. With around 3,500 people across approximately 150 locations, we deliver outstanding customer service and get over 300,000 people and businesses back on the road every year. With AMA Group, you can go anywhere.

 

 CAPITAL SMART 

With over 50 repair centres across Australia and New Zealand, Capital S.M.A.R.T is the industry leader We are the pioneers of customer satisfaction and innovation standards, and pride ourselves on providing our employees with safe, supportive, and rewarding working conditions. With an extensive network across Australia and New Zealand, as part of our Team, you can go anywhere.

 

ACM PARTS

ACM Parts is Australia’s largest provider of alternative and specialty parts to the automotive repair industry, keeping vehicles on the road. We are reimaging the way vehicles can be repaired by providing a choice of options that suit their needs. We offer a comprehensive range of Reclaimed, Genuine, and Aftermarket parts as. ACM Parts is reinventing the quality and service standards of the repair industry. It’s our mission to re-define and repair.

 

The Opportunity
We have an exciting opportunity for Centre Manager at either of our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team. This is a full time position. 

Reporting to the State Operations Manager, you will take ownership of this centre by providing leadership and motivation to your team whilst having a significant impact on the day to day operational running of the site. This permanent full-time role will be provide you with opportunities for growth, stability and security as part of the bigger AMA Group. 

Role responsibilities
Production Workshop Management: oversee production management of the workshop to ensure targets are achieved and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition in accordance with AMA and Work Provider quality expectations.

Quality, Quotes, Parts and Vehicle Management: ensure comprehensive and accurate quotes, QA inspections and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition. 
Customer Service and Stakeholder Management: provide exceptional customer service to all clients and work providers through prompt, professional and friendly interactions.
Profit and Loss, Reporting and Administration: ensure the site is operating profitability. Prepare and review P&Ls, Budgets, Job costings, KPIs, Management Reports by utilising the tools provided to understand site performance.
Leadership and People Management: oversee staffing on site and ensure staffing levels and processes are in place. Proactively build and maintain positive work provider relationships.
Work Health and Safety (WHS): ensure that the site remains safe by maintaining the WHS management system, all WHS policies and procedures are followed and safety incidences/near misses are immediately reported and actioned.
 

Benefits

Reward & recognition
Career development and training
Referral bonus for recommending a friend to work with us
Discounts on parts and tools
Uniforms
24/7 professional counselling for Team members and their immediate families
We champion our Team, because it’s our people that set us apart and drive our business' success. We focus on individual strengths and value differences to bring the best out of people, enhancing their skills and capabilities to build fulfilling careers. 

AMA Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to finding the best fit for every role. All qualified applications will be considered regardless of gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, disability, or sexual orientation.

No matter who you are, if you have the drive and talent to progress, when you’re part of our Team, you’re going places - APPLY NOW.

*Experienced in planning, preparing and managing civil drawing packages and using AutoCAD

*Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to ensure technical accuracy and design efficiency
*Apply relevant Australian standards, local government requirements, and Austroads guidelines in design solutions

Collier & Miller is here to help you source and supply a huge range of specialty and consumer products within the Agricultural, Engineering and industrial sectors. We are currently seeking to hire a qualified and experienced Mechanical Trade (Fitting) to join our manufacturing department in Griffith NSW.  

Mechanical Trade (Fitting) 
At Collier & Miller, a Fitter is an advanced mechanical technician specializing in the installation, 
manufacturing, maintenance, and repair of industrial machinery, parts, and mechanical systems. This 
role requires a high level of technical expertise, advanced problem-solving skills, and a strong 
commitment to safety. 

Core Capabilities: 

Precision Installation and Assembly: 

-  Lead installation and assembly of machinery, including pumps and electric motors, ensuring
precise alignment to engineering standards
-  Utilize advanced fitting techniques, including CNC programming, tool setting, and high precision machinery, to manufacture, shape, align, and assemble parts and subassemblies
with exact tolerances

Expert Maintenance and Repairs:

-  Perform in-depth diagnostics on mechanical systems to identify faults and determine the
best repair methods, ensuring rapid resolution and minimal disruption to operations
-  Repair, test, and reassemble critical equipment, including fluid power systems, to uphold
safety and operational integrity

Technical Interpretation and CNC Programming:

-  Interpret engineering drawings and specifications to guide material selection, machining, and
operations
-  Program CNC machinery and adjust setups to meet detailed technical requirements of each
Project

Machining and Assembly of Metal Parts:

-  Fabricate and install metal parts and subassemblies for machines and equipment, ensuring
proper fit and alignment using high-precision measuring tools and techniques
-  Fit, assemble, and inspect metal components for accuracy, clearance, and precise
functionality within machinery

Hydraulic and Pneumatic System Installation:

-  Cut, thread, bend, and install hydraulic and pneumatic lines, adhering to safety and
operational standards

Operational Maintenance and System Overhaul:

-  Perform maintenance and overhauls on mechanical and fluid power systems to ensure
consistent operational performance
-  Recommend preventative maintenance to optimize machinery longevity and efficiency
Advanced Troubleshooting:
-  Diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues, providing process improvements for 
enhanced system functionality and efficiency

Skills and Qualifications Required:

Advanced Certification in Mechanical Fitting and Engineering:
-  Certificate III in Engineering - Mechanical Trade or equivalent qualification, with extensive 
experience in industrial mechanical fitting and system maintenance

Extensive Technical Expertise in Mechanical Systems:

-  Advanced knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, including the 
operation of specialized equipment such as CNC lathes

Leadership and Mentorship Abilities:

-  Demonstrated ability to mentor junior staff and provide leadership in complex maintenance 
tasks, fostering technical growth and team improvement


Salary range is $70,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with experience

Full-time Position available

Application opens on 21st of July 2026 and closes on 21st of August 2026. 

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted
